# Orvio 1.0

- TV guide for M3U playlists: Orvio reads the XMLTV guide your playlist names, or one you enter yourself.
- Kids profiles are stricter: adult and horror titles stay out, also in a category called Kids.
- Safer: your login no longer reaches the system log, and links from other apps can no longer show their own text in Orvio.
- A provider's broken entry no longer stops a whole import.
- Smoother: posters fade in, settings pages slide, switches glide, lists fade when you filter.
- With two or more playlists, returning to Orvio no longer reloads your whole library.
- On a TV the remote now moves between username and password.
